capabilities: Imports BOOX notebooks as lossless PDF or PNG pages
Converts book highlights and annotations to Markdown notes
Imports calendar memos and cloud attachments
Reads from the tablet itself or from the BOOX cloud
Tracks written files with checksums so edits are never overwritten
disambiguation: Not a two-way sync despite the name: it only imports BOOX content into the vault and never changes anything on the tablet or in the BOOX account.
extras: No telemetry; cloud session token kept in the system keychain via Obsidian secret storage. Requires Obsidian 1.13.0+ (older versions use release 1.0.1). Limits: handwriting is not converted to searchable text; page templates and backgrounds are not drawn. Independent project, not affiliated with Onyx International or BOOX.
problem: Handwritten notebooks, calendar memos and book highlights made on a BOOX e-ink tablet stay trapped in the BOOX apps and cloud, with no way to bring them into an Obsidian vault.
summary: Importer that pulls notebooks, calendar memos and book highlights from a BOOX e-ink tablet or its cloud into Obsidian as PDF, PNG and Markdown.
